title: Builders' Bottles
description: A vanilla-style texture pack that vastly changes potions, splash potions, and lingering potions' base shape, honey/exp/dragon breath included! (should have full mod support)
body:
A vanilla-style resource pack that changes bottle shapes for the three kinds (normal, splash, and lingering)!
Normal potions/bottles and honey bottles become glass cups that look like teacups.
Splash potions and dragon breath become wine bottles.
Lingering potions and bottles o' enchanting become flasks.

Ominous bottles have not been retextured.

Should be fully mod compatible and compatible with texture packs that change potion colors! (like a texture pack to bring back old colors, so long as it didn't individually texture every one of them)
Works on old versions of minecraft as well.

You may use this texture pack in youtube videos, modpacks, etc. so long as you link back here so people may find it. (if the modpack is on modrinth that should be done for you)

Please do not repost the textures or use them in your own texture packs without permission. You may make similar packs if you feel inspired, though.

Credit to my friend SurferWorm (and some to EchoingMoon) for the idea and feedback throughout the process.
